name: Inukai Hibiki
source:
3rd year high school student.
Hibiki is the most mature member of the Guardians he is best friends with Shinagu. Hibiki was raised with the belief that everything has some sort of logical solution, thus he believes anything can be solved by logic. Hibiki maintains excellent grades and enjoys reading and studying, Hibiki's hobbies consist of solving math puzzles and calligraphy. Hibiki is the student council president and is very good at presenting speeches. [spoiler]It is later that Amamiya Otoha is the biological sister of Hibiki who was put up for adoption after the death of his mother as his father needed one child to continue the Inukai legacy.

In the game in Hibiki's route Hibiki initially hates Saya according to him she has a helpless look on her face, but he also uses his powers on Saya. Eventually Hibiki starts to see Saya in a whole new light after seeing how much effort she shows, once when Hibiki comes into her home he realises how Saya has always been alone. Hibiki also cares very much for Otoha and will do anything to help her. [/spoiler]
[From [url=https://hiironokakerashintamayorihimedenshou.fandom.com/wiki/Inukai_Hibiki]Wikia[/url].]
